summary: Remote WebSocket peer drives a host PTY, enabling full-host RCE on the installer
details: The package's main entry runs as a self-executing agent that opens a WebSocket to a configured server and dispatches incoming messages to a broad remote-control surface. In terminal.js, handleTerminalInput writes network-sourced bytes directly into a spawned host PTY (`term.pty.write(msg.data)`), where the shell is `process.env.SHELL || 'bash'` (or powershell/cmd on Windows), giving the remote WebSocket peer arbitrary command execution under the agent user's identity. Additional message-router cases perform arbitrary file read/write/delete, file transfers, and git commit/push under the same channel. Separately, on agent startup, ensureYeaftSkills() git-clones https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev at a mutable branch with no commit pin, `git pull --ff-only`s it on each launch, and writes `enabledPlugins[yeaft-skills@yeaft-skills-dev]=true` into ~/.claude/settings.json — a persistent, unpinned code-push channel into the installer's Claude CLI plugin surface, independent of npm versioning.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
